wb = load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb.active

# Totals by the category headers in H5:J5, matching the selected item in the
# PARTICULARS column (D) and summing the corresponding AMOUNT column (F).
# Using formulas implements the requested Excel functionality dynamically.
for col in range(8, 11):  # H:J
    header_cell = ws.cell(row=5, column=col).coordinate
    ws.cell(row=8, column=col).value = f'=SUMIF($D:$D,{header_cell},$F:$F)'

# Ensure Excel recalculates these formulas when opened.
try:
    wb.calculation.fullCalcOnLoad = True
    wb.calculation.forceFullCalc = True
    wb.calculation.calcMode = "auto"
except Exception:
    pass

wb.save(output_path)

print("Saved:", output_path)
print("H8:J8:", [ws.cell(row=8, column=c).value for c in range(8, 11)])
